rows: What is the parcel identifier and street address?
Obtain the APN and address from the recorded deed in an access-controlled internal workspace; never enter them on this site.
Which Census tract(s) make up the trade area?
Read the Census Tract field on the ZIMAS Jurisdictional tab; fix a written tract set (primary + ring) and version it.
What is the exact expiration date of the NNN lease?
Commission a private lease abstract from the executed lease and all amendments; reconcile the single date to the notice calendar.
What are the base rent, escalations and any percentage rent?
Extract from the lease and rent roll; note rents are net investment income under IRS Topic 559.
Are there renewal options, and who can exercise them?
Abstract option language, exercise window, and any co-tenancy, assignment, ROFR or holdover clauses.
What notice deadlines must be met before a sale or renewal commitment?
Build a private notice calendar from the lease; reconcile it against the abstract before any commitment.
Who is the obligor and what guarantees or sublease structures exist?
Check the lease, any guaranty, and the tenant's public filings; a franchised unit may be operated by a franchisee, not the public parent.
What are the parcel's zoning and General Plan land use designations?
Look up the parcel in ZIMAS; record zone, overlays, community plan area, entitlements and permit history.
Is the parcel in a Fire Hazard Severity Zone, and which responsibility area?
Use the State Fire Marshal FHSZ viewer with the address; record the classification and the locally adopted ordinance.
What is the parcel's effective FEMA flood zone and FIRM panel?
Address search in the NFHL Viewer / Map Service Center; save the FIRMette and check pending or preliminary map changes.
Is the parcel in an Alquist-Priolo fault, liquefaction, landslide or tsunami zone?
Check EQ ZApp, the sole authoritative source of California Earthquake Zones of Required Investigation; disclosure may be required on sale.
What is the annual average daily traffic on the frontage road?
Select route and postmile from the parcel, then download the 2024 AADT file; for a city street, request counts from the local Public Works/Traffic Engineering department.
What are the tract-level population, income and employment trends?
Request a Census API key, pull the same ACS 5-year tables for at least three vintages for the fixed tract set, and pin the vintage.
What is the local competitor set for quick-service restaurants?
Use County Business Patterns / CBP by NAICS at tract or ZIP level plus a privately verified field survey; publish only counts.
What is the population trend for the county and city?
County -0.6% and city -0.9% from January 1, 2025 to January 1, 2026; Census V2025 shows -3.2% county / -0.8% city from the 2020 base to July 1, 2025.
Extend to tract level once Q-02 is answered; do not mix vintages.
What are area income levels and how do city and county compare?
Median household income 2020-2024: $90,112 county and $81,939 city (in 2024 dollars).
Replace these proxies with trade-area figures once Q-02 is answered (W-01).
Is local employment growing, and in which industries?
October 2026 total nonfarm employment in Los Angeles County was 4,662,800, up 40,700 (0.9%) year over year; food services and drinking places rose 7,500 while information fell 2,600.
Both sources mark the newest month preliminary; re-check before a commitment.
What long-run growth forecast is officially adopted for the region?
Connect SoCal 2024 projects SCAG-region employment of 10,276,000 by 2050 from 8,976,000 in 2019, and a baseline 2050 population of 20.8 million (range 19.85-21.9 million).
Treat as a projection with assumptions, not an observation; do not extrapolate to a single parcel.
What is the tenant/operator direction across multiple periods?
System same-store sales: +0.4% (Q1 FY2025), (4.4%) (Q2), (7.1%) (Q3), (4.2%) (FY2025) vs (1.3%) (FY2024); system units fell from 2,191 to 2,136.
Series shows direction, not one quarter; unit-level data still required.
What school-system evidence is officially available?
Los Angeles Unified enrollment was 497,105 in 2025-26 (largest district in California); statewide enrollment 5,731,260.
Use aggregate district figures only; never publish student-level data.
What is the earthquake hazard context for the region?
USGS/UCERF3 30-year probabilities for the Los Angeles region: 60% for M6.7, 46% for M7, 31% for M7.5.
Replace regional context with parcel zone status (Q-11) and an engineering report.
What is the insurance availability context?
CDI reported 677,449 FAIR Plan homeowner policies statewide (Nov 20, 2026 snapshot) and commercial FAIR Plan counts of 21,200 to 21,464 in Q1 2026.
Statewide counts are context only; obtain property-specific quotes.
What are the actual property insurance quotes, deductibles and exclusions?
Obtain at least three written quotes including earthquake, flood and fire; NFIP policies typically have a 30-day waiting period.
Has an engineering / seismic / environmental report been completed?
Commission privately; stress loss of rent, repairs and exit liquidity together.
What verified tax rules govern an after-tax sale comparison?

Federal long-term rates 0/15/20% (2025 thresholds), 25% maximum on unrecaptured section 1250 gain, 3.8% NIIT; California taxes all capital gains as ordinary income; Prop 13 sets a 1% base rate plus voter-approved debt.
Apply only with owner-specific inputs; see the after-tax module.
What is the owner's adjusted basis, accumulated depreciation and holding period?
Obtain from the private tax file; IRS requires basis to be reduced by depreciation allowed or allowable, whichever is greater.
What is the parcel's tax rate area and current secured tax bill?
Retrieve the secured bill from the county portal; the 1% base rate plus local indebtedness varies by area.
Will a section 1031 exchange be used, and is replacement property identified?
Decide privately with a qualified intermediary; since January 1, 2018 section 1031 applies only to real property.
What is the verified short-lease discount from real quotes?
Collect arm's-length broker quotes / recorded comparable sales of short-lease QSR assets with remaining term; publish only the aggregate spread.
What is the negotiated renewal case (rent, term, tenant improvements, credit)?
Obtain a written renewal proposal before pricing the hold case; no winner is selected until this exists.
Are there environmental, title or litigation encumbrances?
Private title report, Phase I environmental site assessment and litigation search.
What are the owner's liquidity, concentration and return objectives?
Discuss privately with advisers; keep owner financials offline and out of this website.
Has the versioned cash-flow model been back-tested?
Only back-test once verified inputs and sufficient comparable history exist; distinguish observations from assumptions.
No winner is selected on this public site. Run the private calculator after gates G1-G8 pass.
